target.title: feat: Auto-generate session titles from first user message
target.body:
## Summary

Adds title-based session naming similar to ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude. After the first reply in a new session, an LLM call generates a concise 3-6 word title (e.g. "Python Array Sorting Help") and stores it as `displayName`, which is what `deriveSessionTitle` returns.

This replaces the current behavior of just truncating the first user message at 60 characters.

## Changes

- **`dashboard-session-title.ts`** — Generalized from dashboard-only to all sessions
  - Renamed functions: `isSessionTitleCandidate`, `maybeGenerateSessionTitle`, `normalizeSessionTitle`
  - Old dashboard-specific names kept as deprecated aliases for backward compat
  - Dashboard sessions always get titles (existing behavior preserved)
  - Non-dashboard sessions require `isNewSession` + `autoTitle` config enabled
  - Uses existing `generateConversationLabel` (no duplication)

- **`chat.ts`** — Extended title generation trigger to all sessions
  - Checks `cfg.session?.autoTitle !== false` (default: true)
  - Detects first turn via `!entry || entry.sessionId !== admittedSessionId || !entry.systemSent`
  - Emits `sessionsChanged` with reason `chat.title` after title is persisted (same as dashboard path)

- **`zod-schema.session.ts`** — Added `autoTitle: z.boolean().optional()` to `SessionSchema`
  - Runtime config parsing now accepts the new key

- **`types.base.ts`** — Added `session.autoTitle?: boolean` to `SessionConfig`

- **`schema.labels.ts`** — Added schema label for the config UI

## Config

```yaml
session:
  autoTitle: true  # default, set false to disable
```

## How it works

1. User sends first message in a new session
2. Agent generates a reply (as normal)
3. **After** the reply is sent, a background LLM call generates a title from the user message
4. Title is persisted as `displayName` on the session entry
5. `sessionsChanged` event emitted so Control UI updates immediately
6. `deriveSessionTitle` returns the AI-generated title instead of raw first-message truncation

The entire title generation is fire-and-forget — it never adds latency to the reply path.

## Addressed Codex review findings

- [x] **P1: Zod schema** — Added `autoTitle` to `SessionSchema` so runtime parsing accepts the key
- [x] **P1: Duplicate implementation** — Generalized existing `maybeGenerateDashboardSessionTitle` instead of duplicating; removed `auto-session-title.ts`
- [x] **P1: Session-change notification** — Title generation from `chat.ts` emits `sessionsChanged` with `reason: chat.title`

## Proof

To verify: send a first message in a new webchat session. The session list should show an AI-generated title (e.g. "Python Help Request") instead of the raw first message truncated at 60 chars.
